levels.name: Capstone · Final Project
levels.theme: Plan, Build and Share a Digital Project

sessions.title: Meet Your Computer
sessions.summary: Input, process and output; desktop vs laptop hardware; safe startup and shutdown; mouse and touchpad control.

sessions.title: Keyboard Mastery & First Typing
sessions.summary: The four keyboard zones, home row, Backspace vs Delete, posture and first typing drills.

sessions.title: The Desktop & Programmes
sessions.summary: Desktop anatomy, opening programmes, the three window buttons, moving, resizing and multitasking.

sessions.title: Files, Folders & File Explorer
sessions.summary: Files vs folders, the filing hierarchy, File Explorer, the BIH file-naming standard and illegal characters.

sessions.title: File Operations & Typing Fluency
sessions.summary: Copy vs cut, renaming with F2, the Recycle Bin, USB drives and safe ejection, typing fluency.

sessions.title: Searching the Web & Internet Foundations
sessions.summary: Internet vs the Web, browsers, URLs and domains, HTTPS, keyword searching and checking sources.

sessions.title: Email & Digital Communication
sessions.summary: The digital post office, email addresses, To/Cc/Subject, netiquette and attachments.

sessions.title: Create & Format Documents (Part 1)
sessions.summary: Word processor vocabulary, fonts, formatting styles, alignment and fast text selection.

sessions.title: Create & Format Documents (Part 2)
sessions.summary: Bullets vs numbers, visual hierarchy, built-in styles, spell-check and the Ghanaian name dilemma.

sessions.title: Spreadsheets, Tables & Basic Formulas
sessions.summary: The market trader's ledger, cell addresses, data types, formulas, operators and AutoFill.

sessions.title: Functions, Ranges & Visual Charts
sessions.summary: Ranges, SUM/AVERAGE/MAX/MIN, choosing chart types and selecting the right cells.

sessions.title: Presentations & Slide Design
sessions.summary: The speaker and the signboard, the 6-by-6 rule, contrast, layouts and aspect ratio.

sessions.title: Presentation Delivery & Public Speaking
sessions.summary: Animations without the carnival, slideshow shortcuts, delivery, citing sources and handling questions.

sessions.title: Digital Collaboration & Teamwork
sessions.summary: Nnoboa teamwork, sharing permissions, collaborative roles, version history and helpful comments.

sessions.title: Online Safety & Digital Citizenship
sessions.summary: Personal information, digital footprints, T.H.I.N.K., strong passphrases and spotting phishing.

sessions.title: Block Programming & Algorithms
sessions.summary: The kelewele recipe algorithm, Scratch zones, events, motion blocks and the coordinate stage.

sessions.title: Loops, Decisions & Debugging
sessions.summary: Loops, conditions, sensing, variables, bugs and a clean-up mini-game.

sessions.title: Capstone Planning & Blueprint
sessions.summary: Choosing a capstone track, the project charter, safe data ethics and prototype v0.1.

sessions.title: Capstone Building, Testing & Iteration
sessions.summary: User testing, useful feedback, version tracking and the build-and-test sprint.

sessions.title: Showcase Demo Day & Graduation
sessions.summary: The 3-minute pitch formula, stage choreography, the pre-flight checklist and reflection.
